assign.outcome:
**The dev socket now connects on any host (wss on https) and the server decides what a peer may do.**

- [x] client tries everywhere, one quiet console line: [Socket.js](/framework/dev/Socket/Socket.js), rule in [lan.md](/framework/dev/Socket/doc/lan.md); a refused host gives up after about five minutes and nothing parks
- [x] server side checked from the LAN address, http and https: connected, a command answered refused, a tail arrived in 9 ms, a forged origin got 401
- [x] [Now](/live/now/) redraws about 1.3 s after an in-flight session logs (a tail of its cache.jsonl); [notes.md](/live/doc/notes.md) corrected
- [ ] the phone gets wss on https only after a dev-server restart (the https listener had no socket; fixed in Server/plugins)
- [ ] Last landed and Waiting stay empty on the phone: the task tree asks the socket's query, which LAN peers are refused (open, in notes.md)
